description: This file defines a React-like component using Qwik framework, for creating a new note with input handlers and save logic, and includes page metadata.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Main component function for creating and editing a note.

methods.name: onChangeTitle$
methods.description: Updates the note's title state when changed.

methods.name: onChangeContent$
methods.description: Updates the note's content state when changed.

methods.name: onChangeTags$
methods.description: Updates the note's tags state when changed.

methods.name: onSave$
methods.description: Saves the note through API and navigates to the note's page.
